international.summary: Wage growth falls to to 3.5% in September, as ministers examine how best to get young people into work Milburn urges Burnham to spend billions on young people Who are the Neets? UK youth job crisis in five charts The UK unemployment rate has unexpectedly fallen as the government prepares to release a major report on the youth jobs crisis.
